package hack

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestMutableString(t *testing.T) {
	var b []byte
	var s MutableString
	s = String(b)
	require.Equal(t, "0x0", s)
	s = String([]byte("hello"))
	require.Equal(t, "hello", s)
	s = String([]byte("hello"), 5)
	require.Equal(t, "hello", s)
	s = String([]byte("hello"), 0)
	require.Equal(t, "", s)
	s = String([]byte("hello"), 100)
	require.Equal(t, "hello", s)
	s = Slice(s)
	require.Equal(t, []byte("hello"), s)
	s = Slice(string(s))
	require.Equal(t, []byte("hello"), s)
}

func TestGetBytesFromPtr(t *testing.T) {
	b := []byte("hello")
	ptr := &b
	s := GetBytesFromPtr(ptr, len(b))
	require.Equal(t, b, s)
}
